scope: Review the separate opt-in HS200 draft against frozen v21 HS25/HS50, actual T736 Tina donor, Linux 6.18 MMC core, and A733 manual.
No edits to frozen v21 driver/package/updater, no board commands, no flashing, no default promotion.
Suitable to construct a separately identified guarded candidate; static review is not permission to claim HS200 hardware success.

findings_resolved.finding: A failed CMD12 abort can itself report FIFO/HW-lock errors; checking only dma_dead after abort could continue the scan after a hardware fault.
findings_resolved.resolution: Final driver checks dma_dead, ios_error and RINT[11/12] immediately after CMD12. Failure IRQ/IDST are captured before cleanup CMD12 overwrites diagnostics.

findings_resolved.finding: At high-rate reads, matching THLD to block size enables meaningful block-gap FIFO protection; tuning cannot validate subsequent multiblock reads by itself.
findings_resolved.resolution: HS200 transfer setup sets THLD to current block size 128/512 with read/write direction, verifies controlled bits, preserves BCIG and SFC, and restores legacy THLD on non-HS200 set_ios.

findings_resolved.finding: Earlier T527/AvaotaA1 reference was not the actual T736 donor.
findings_resolved.resolution: Independently re-read and SHA-checked all three actual T736 donor sources. Actual donor has optional kernel tuning with 64 taps, minimum window12 and20 trials.

verified_in_source.enablement: enable_hs200 defaults false; only HS200_1_8V_SDR is advertised when explicitly enabled. Fixed1.8V callback performs no rail/PMIC writes. HS400/DDR52 not enabled.
verified_in_source.clock: Exact integer/rational validation of 26MHz DCXO ->24MHz REF ->800MHz PERI0; ready/lock/source/SDM checks retained.100MHz=M4/N1 and200MHz=M2/N1 with SDR module/2. No shared PLL writes.
verified_in_source.phases: Actual T736 HS200 uses CMD180/DATA90, distinct from donor SD SDR104 DATA180 case. SDR/NTSR/EDSD/CSDC fields are masked/read-back checked.
verified_in_source.tuning: 64 physical delay taps are linear, without endpoint wrapping. Passing tap requires20 successful128-byte JEDEC transfers. Longest window>=12 gives>=5tap edge margin; earliest equal-length tie is deterministic. Center is revalidated16 times.
verified_in_source.fresh_data: Every CMD21 trial poisons128B coherent buffer with0xa5. Existing completion requires controller completion, DMA direction event and descriptor OWN clear; DMA stop/reset precedes copy; Linux core compares all128 bytes.
verified_in_source.data_gate: Before a valid tuning point, worker rejects ordinary HS200 data; synchronous tuning CMD21 is allowed and non-data initialization commands remain possible.
verified_in_source.abort: Expected bad-tap CRC/timeout/pattern mismatch remains a failed tap. CMD12 abort errors are recorded separately and cannot mark a passing tap. Following traffic remains read-only CMD21 until full tuning succeeds. No host->card dereference during initialization.
verified_in_source.fatal: CMD21 IDST[4/5], RINT[11/12], dma_dead, ios_error or unexpected error terminate scan. Post-abort hardware checks prevent hardware-fault continuation.
verified_in_source.bounds: 30s soft deadline is checked at each tap, trial and pre-abort; tuning command poll is200ms. Clock-update/DMA-reset and cleanup are separately bounded and can extend total wall time; this is not a hard30s guarantee.
verified_in_source.cleanup: Failure leaves tuning_valid=false and ios_error blocks future data. Abort, DMA-stop and clock-stop results plus original IRQ/IDST are logged. DMA-dead quarantines allocations; tuning cleanup/set_ios skip clock programming after dma_dead. Existing command tail can still clear IRQSTATUS.
verified_in_source.retuning: Same actual frequency can preserve tuned tap; changing actual frequency invalidates and requests retuning. Leaving HS200 invalidates. Board seed values never substitute for successful CMD21.
verified_in_source.fallback: Core mmc_init_card does not promise automatic HS52 fallback after execute_tuning failure. Recovery must keep persistent v16 and accepted v21 boot paths available externally.

mainline_core.independently_read: 676-743 mmc_send_tuning uses full pattern compare at736;745-768 abort emits CMD12 R1/AC, no card pointer required.
mainline_core.initialization_note: mmc.c tunes before host->card is assigned; caller must not use host->card/CMD13 recovery during initial tuning.
mainline_core.abort_precedent: renesas_sdhi_core.c calls mmc_send_abort_tuning on command error without treating all abort failures as fatal; hardware faults still require separate rejection here.
